theorem lg_target {α : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] [One α] [Sub α] [PredSubOrder α] {b : α} (hb : ¬IsMin b) : Set.Iic (b - 1) = Set.Iio b := by
  -- Show Set.Iic (b - 1) ⊆ Set.Iio b
  have h1 : Set.Iic (b - 1) ⊆ Set.Iio b :=
    fun x => by
      rw [Set.Iic, Set.Iio]
      intro h_le
      exact le_antisymm_iff.1 (le_trans h_le (lt_iff_le_not_le.2 (ne_of_gt (pred_lt b hb))))
  -- Show Set.Iio b ⊆ Set.Iic (b - 1)
  have h2 : Set.Iio b ⊆ Set.Iic (b - 1) :=
    fun x => by
      rw [Set.Iic, Set.Iio]
      intro h_lt
      exact lt_irrefl b (lt_trans h_lt (lt_iff_le_not_le.1 (le_pred b)))
  -- Conclude equality
  exact Set.ext h1 h2
